attchmntText: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Analysts/Investors meetings scheduled to be held on Tuesday, November 17, 2026
voiceSummary: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited has intimated that its management will participate in an investor conference organized by Avendus Spark. The event is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, from 10 am to 5 pm. The meeting will be held physically in Mumbai. It will include both group and one-on-one meetings with investors and analysts. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed or disclosed during these interactions. The dates and times are subject to change due to unexpected exigencies. An investor presentation for Q2FY27 and H1FY27 is available for reference.

attchmntText: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of earnings conference call on the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited filed a transcript of the earnings conference call held on November 03, 2026, regarding Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported nearly 4.6 million control intensive ECUs sold in the trailing twelve months ending Q2 FY27, representing 44% year-on-year growth. Revenue growth exceeded 40% for both Q2 and H1 FY27. EBITDA margins dipped due to rising raw material costs, while PAT was affected by a shift to the new tax regime. The company highlighted the full ramp-up of ISG ECUs for export ICE three-wheelers and electric two-wheeler MCUs. Pilot production has commenced at the new MF3 plant, with a new facility planned for Shoolagiri, Tamil Nadu. Management noted improved customer concentration metrics and an 11.4% revenue share from EV products in the two and three-wheeler segment.

attchmntText: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 4390  Shares.
voiceSummary: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited has allotted 4,390 equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each to eligible employees who exercised options under the Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee passed this resolution via circulation on November 07, 2026. These shares rank pari-passu with existing equity shares. The company's issued, subscribed, and paid-up share capital has increased from Rs. 44,21,51,100 divided into 4,42,15,110 equity shares to Rs. 44,21,95,000 divided into 4,42,19,500 equity shares.
